endorsements.name: Ryan Kelso
endorsements.label: Securing Secrets to a Billion Dollars
endorsements.description: In this talk, we’ll be presenting the problem of securing secrets used in infrastructure-as-code, how to approach this problem, and the nuances of addressing the risk of secrets management. We’ll provide concrete examples, leveraging cloud technologies and Infrastructure-As-Code tooling, as well as various CI/CD processes and technologies. The scenario we’ll be presenting will be securing secrets for use within the cryptoexchange industry and the threats and risks of exposing those secrets even internal to the organization.
